raw_response:
This plot is small, only a quarter of a timad really, but maize is what feeds my family so I must treat it well. I went to school a bit, so I know DAP at planting and urea for top-dressing help the maize, and last year the cooperative brought fertilizer on time — I will buy a small share, maybe half a bag of DAP and half a bag of urea split with what I use on my other plots. I will use improved seed from the cooperative because my neighbor got better cobs last season with BH-660, and on such a small plot the extra cost is bearable. I cannot irrigate here — there is no water source — and I will not spend money on pesticide unless army worm comes; I will weed by hand with my wife and older children.
